uncited: It builds on [Parallel Volume Rendering with Static Load Balancing](2547-parallel-volume-rendering-with-static-load-balancing.md) by implementing the static partitioning and compositing overlap specifically for unstructured grids using a hierarchical data structure.
**Inputs:** Unstructured-grid dataset (nodes, elements, scalar values), number of processors $p$, camera/viewing position.
**Exterior Faces:** Faces not shared by any element.
*   **Globally Exterior:** Boundary of the entire volume.
**Domain Partitioning:** Partition the computational domain into $p$ subvolumes, where $p$ is the number of processors.
*   **Globally Interior Faces Becoming Locally Exterior:** After domain partitioning, faces that were interior to the global volume may become boundaries of a subvolume.
*   **Time Complexity:** Not given in the sources.
